DAVID QUISPE
da.qc@outlook.com | portfolio | Madrid, Spain (open to relocation)

Systems Engineer with focus on Cybersecurity and AI/ML frameworks.

EXPERIENCE
FIAP (Public Administration Internationalization Foundation) | Madrid, Spain (hybrid)
Spanish public foundation managing international cooperation projects to strengthen governance and public policies.
Position: Cybersecurity Technician | September 2024 – June 2025
Responsibilities:
• Implemented cybersecurity strategies covering vulnerability intelligence, endpoint protection, threat detection, and enforcement of
information security policies, ensuring alignment with national and international standards.
Achievements:
➢ Initiated and led a Vulnerability Intelligence program to proactively identify and address internal cybersecurity risks.
➢ Developed PoCs with MS Copilot, open-source LLMs, and agentic frameworks to automate Cyber Threat Intelligence.
➢ Supported inventory management, auditing, and incident response using EDR solutions and CCN-CERT tools.
➢ Enhanced network security by managing and optimizing Fortinet technologies, reducing exploitable vulnerabilities
➢ Secured the Microsoft 365 environment (SharePoint, Exchange, Defender, etc.) by applying Zero Trust (ZTNA) principles.
➢ Contributed to the drafting and improvement of Information Security Policies, aligning practices with organizational needs.
➢ Supported the implementation and compliance efforts with national and international cybersecurity standards and regulations, including ENS,
NIST, and CCN-CERT.

PLAWLABS LTD. | London, UK (remote)
Tech Startup focused on AI-powered virtual assistant solutions and custom software development.
Position: AI/ML Engineer | July 2024 – September 2024 Direct Reports: 1
Responsibilities:
• Implemented and tested both open-source and proprietary Large Language Models (LLMs) to accomplish specific tasks, collaborating with
cross-functional teams to deliver tailored solutions and successfully execute Proof of Concept (PoC) projects focused on LLM workloads.
Achievements:
➢ Fine-tuned and optimized LLaMA 3.1 8B and 70B models using quantization and PEFT (Parameter Efficient Fine-Tuning) techniques to
create custom adapters and integrate them with base models for improved performance.
➢ Developed and deployed a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) system with an embedded model and vector database for efficient text
retrieval and precise response generation.
➢ Applied prompt engineering techniques, including few-shot learning and active prompting, to enhance model output accuracy and
responsiveness.
➢ Deployed AI agents using LangChain and Langroid, leveraging tool-calling and task management to automate processes and interact with
external applications, significantly boosting operational efficiency.

HAMB INGENIERÍA Y CONSTRUCCIÓN S.A.C. | Cusco, Perú (on-premise)
Engineering and construction company, specializing in project development, civil works management, specialized systems, and real
estate development.
Position (internship): Full Stack Web Developer | January 2022 – September 2022 Direct Reports: 2
Responsibilities:
• Led an interdisciplinary team to design, develop, and deploy HAMBIC S.A.C.'s web application, leveraging Laravel (backend), React
(frontend), MySQL, and WordPress with Elementor for no-code solutions, delivering a robust and scalable platform.
Achievements:
➢ Successfully implemented the SAP system, optimizing inventory control and reducing inefficiencies by 30%.
➢ Enhanced the main domain's web application, resulting in a 25% increase in the customer base.
➢ Boosted the sales team's productivity by 20% through the implementation and training on the use of a CRM.
